# `min-items-decreased`

minItems decreased

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `info` in requests, `warn` in responses |
| **Rule IDs** | `min-items-decreased` (both directions), `min-items-decreased-in-request`, `min-items-decreased-in-response` |
| **Status** | Planned (M5) |
| **Group** | Schemas ([RULES.md section 7](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

`minItems` decreased.

## Why this default

In requests: more arrays are valid. In responses: clients may receive shorter (e.g. empty) arrays than they expect.

## Example

_No example yet: one is added with the rule's test case when the rule is implemented._

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file, for the generic ID or any variant ID above (the more specific ID wins). The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  min-items-decreased: warn
```

## How to fix

Check that clients handle the shorter arrays.
